name: Huion Foldable Stand ST200

description_html:
Suitable for Kamvas series and Kamvas Pro series smaller than 16″ size.
Adjustable Stand ST200
Ergonomic Design for You
This ST200 stand can be moved between 20 and 60 degrees to suit your working way, which helps reduce tension for your neck, shoulder and back, and offers you the best viewing angle for drawing and typing.

Fold, and Carry it Around
Just fold the stand into an 7.6mm thin and flat piece, then you can easily put it in your bag and carry it around.

Forget Wonky, Stay in Position
With the anti-slip mats on the Aluminum-alloy surface, the ST200 stand can help you avoid unnecessary skidding to keep your device in place securely. And the hidden stopper can keep your device in position.

Compatible Products
· Kamvas 12
· Kamvas 13
· Kamvas 16 (2021)
· Kamvas 13 (Gen 3)
· Kamvas Pro 12
· Kamvas Pro 13
· Kamvas Pro 16
· Kamvas Pro 13 (2.5K)
· Kamvas Pro 16 (2.5K)
· Kamvas Pro 16 (4K)
· Kamvas Pro 16 Plus (4K)
